column1: An IfcCivilElement is a generalization of all the elements within a civil engineering work. It includes, in particular, all cases of typical linear construction works, such as road segments, bridge segments, sidewalks, etc.

column4: Holds the entity specific enumerations from the IFC standard that classifies the entity. If a custom value is needed, the attribute ObjectTypeOverride has to be used to define such custom type, whereas the PredefinedType is set to USERDEFINED.
Allows for a custom value to be added, if no applicable PredefinedType enumerator can be found.
